report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.fragment_associations claim, associated review.rs source, and both complete associated tests. This is source inspection; no behavior tests were executed by this reviewer, and central suite execution is reported separately.

ReviewInput stores implementation and test association metadata separately from InputFragment contents. inventory reconstructs the full per-anchor collections in deterministic order. ReviewImplementation includes crate/target/module/file, cfg, excerpt form, region, status and explanation; ReviewTest includes crate/target/Rust path/file, cfg and status. input_errors compares saved/current implementation and test vectors before independently validating fragment content and selectors. Therefore an unchanged captured body does not excuse a changed association or inherited metadata. record and normal review validation use current inventory/input_errors, so the separation applies to recording and later gate checks. Captured correspondence and evidence helpers establish how per-target/module cfg and status metadata are obtained independently of a test function's text, and captured shared check code routes stale-review issues into failure.

added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments starts from an approved one-test input, appends another test and asserts the named anchor's test-associations failure with required review guidance. It asserts two tests in a refreshed deterministic inventory and exact preservation of the original test metadata. After recording that set it removes the second association and again asserts the association failure. It then adds an implementation in another file and requires the distinct implementation-associations diagnostic and a refreshed two-entry implementation list. Thus the test does not merely change a previously captured body to trigger generic staleness.

test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement provides the crucial metadata-only case. It places unchanged TEST text under a cfg(unix) module and asserts crate, target, qualified Rust path, file, inherited unix/test conditions and Ordinary status. Semantic capture must return exactly TEST. After recording, adding unrelated comments/blank lines above the module stays valid. Replacing the enclosing condition with cfg(windows) while keeping TEST identical invalidates the review. Together the positive unrelated-movement assertion and negative inherited-condition assertion establish that metadata is checked separately from selected function contents.

Captured Fixture/TEST helpers create actual Cargo and specification inputs, start/record reviews and read saved input; the decisive checks are visible in the annotated bodies. Both additions/removals and changed association metadata are covered, including implementation/test separation. There are no TODO or N/A entries. No concrete defect or further necessary source edit was identified; requested edits are empty.
